name: 60606 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60606 (Chicago) has 821 nonprofit organizations. 277 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 246 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60606 (Chicago) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
69% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60606 (Chicago) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 34.2 times the typical level).
